name: Ludlow Jute & Specialities Limited
about: Ludlow Jute & Specialities Limited manufactures and sells jute goods in India and internationally. The company provides sack and jute, jute felt, jute gunny, and woven cotton bags; jute hessian cloths; jute home decor and jute non woven geotextile products; and webbing jute tapes, jute yarn, and woven cotton bags. It also offers jute mesh/scrim, rubber bonded jute cloth, and special fabrics. The company was formerly known as Aekta Limited and changed its name to Ludlow Jute & Specialities Limited in May 2008. The company was founded in 1921 and is based in Kolkata, India. Ludlow Jute & Specialities Limited operates as a subsidiary of Panchjanya Distributors Private Limited.
